evidence.ACL: Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without ligament injury.
evidence.MCL: the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with maceration, extrusion and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Intrasubstance degeneration of the lateral meniscus without tear.
evidence.Medial OA: severe changes in the medial compartment with full-thickness cartilage loss of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
evidence.Lateral OA: diffuse mild to moderate thinning of the cartilage in the lateral and patellofemoral compartments
evidence.PF OA: diffuse mild to moderate thinning of the cartilage in the lateral and patellofemoral compartments
evidence.Effusion: There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis.
evidence.Synovitis: There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis.
